headword: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}

definitions.explanation: A shipping option in which an order placed is delivered to the recipient on the same day it is ordered. Offered by many online retailers and services in Japan.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}に{対応|たいおう}しています。
{午前|ごぜん}{中|ちゅう}に{注文|ちゅうもん}すれば{即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}が{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: If you order in the morning, same-day delivery is possible.

examples.japanese: {急|いそ}いでいるので、{即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}のサービスを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: Since I was in a hurry, I chose the same-day delivery service.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}は{一部|いちぶ}の{地域|ちいき}のみ{対応|たいおう}となっております。
examples.english: Same-day delivery is available only in certain areas.

notes:
Composed of {即日|そくじつ} (same day, that very day) + {配送|はいそう} (delivery, shipping). A common commercial term in Japan for fast-delivery services offered by online retailers like Amazon, Rakuten, and major department stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}{可能|かのう}: same-day delivery available
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}{対応|たいおう}: same-day delivery supported
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}サービス: same-day delivery service
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}{無料|むりょう}: free same-day delivery
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}の{締|し}め{切|き}り: same-day delivery deadline (cutoff time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {翌日|よくじつ}{配送|はいそう}: next-day delivery — delivery the day after ordering
- {当日|とうじつ}{配送|はいそう}: day-of delivery — essentially synonymous with {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}
- {速達|そくたつ}: express mail — the postal service's fast option

USAGE:
Typically subject to conditions: orders must be placed before a cutoff time (e.g., {午前|ごぜん}{中|ちゅう}) and are often available only in certain service areas.
